scripts.pripremi: npm link --save --package-lock false express  express-session cookie-parser sqlite3 sqlite cors jsonwebtoken nodemailer base32-encoding totp-generator
scripts.copy-files: copyfiles -u 1 src/**/*.html src/**/*.css src/**/*.jpg src/**/*.png src/**/*.js build/
scripts.start-spider: npm run pripremi && npm run server
scripts.start-local: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run copy-files && npm run server
scripts.debug: npm run compile && npm run copy-files && node --enable-source-maps --inspect-brk=9229 build/server.js
